exposure: Delivery less than 2 years after breast cancer diagnosis
cohort: The study included 74 breast cancer survivors with at least one subsequent delivery after cancer diagnosis between 2010 and 2020, compared to 222 age-matched healthy controls in Southern Germany.
finding: Breast cancer survivors had an increased risk for a small-for-gestational-age (SGA) fetus, and delivery within 2 years after diagnosis was associated with an increased risk for both SGA and low birth weight.
mod_finding: The risk of cesarean section was not significantly increased among breast cancer survivors compared to healthy controls.
